blePermissionsRequired: Bluetooth and location permissions are required to scan and program locks.
bleConnectTimeout: Could not connect to the lock over Bluetooth. Stand within 1 m, wake the lock (touch the keypad), keep scanning, then try again. For locks already on TTLock cloud use Link existing — not Program new.
bleConnectTimeoutProvision: Bluetooth step failed while programming the lock (not the server). Stay within 1 m, wake the lock, tap Initialize again. If the lock is already on TTLock cloud, cancel and use Link existing on the room/unit.
lockNotInSettingMode: This lock is already initialized. Use Link existing on the room/unit, or reset the lock hardware to enter setup mode.
apiBaseHint: Use your PC LAN IP on a real phone (not 10.0.2.2). Example: http://192.168.1.104:8000
apiBaseDevHostOnDevice: 10.0.2.2 and localhost only work on the emulator. On a real phone use your PC’s LAN IP, e.g. http://192.168.1.104:8000
networkUnreachable: Cannot reach the server at {{url}}. Use the same Wi‑Fi as your PC, check Herd is running, and use http://YOUR-PC-IP:8000 (central API, not a tenant subdomain).
ttlockSslError: The server could not connect to TTLock (SSL/certificate). On the Laravel server set TTLOCK_HTTP_VERIFY=false for local dev or install a CA bundle (CURL_CA_BUNDLE).
emptyTenants: No tenants available for your account.
emptySiteHint: Add buildings, gates, elevators, or parking in the tenant admin.
emptySiteSearch: No site units match your search.
emptyProperty: No rooms on this tenant yet.
emptyPropertySearch: No units match your search or filter.
emptyUnlinkedHint: Program a new lock or sync from TTLock cloud from the header.
emptyUnlinkedSearch: No unlinked locks match your search.
unlinkedSearchPlaceholder: Search name, alias, MAC, or lock ID…
lockPayloadConfirmHint: Review all fields (including lock_id and lock_data) before sending.
apiTenantForbidden: You cannot access this tenant. Choose another property or sign in again.
apiPropertyAlreadyHasLock: This unit already has a lock. Open lock details and unlink it before linking another.
apiPropertyNotFound: Room or unit was not found on the server.
apiLockNotFound: Lock was not found. Pull to refresh unlinked locks or sync TTLock from the server.
apiRequestTimeout: The server took too long to respond. Check Wi‑Fi and try again.
apiInvalidResponse: Unexpected response from the server. Check the server URL and that lock-setup API is running.
apiNoTenantSelected: No tenant selected. Go back and choose a property.
provisionLockMissingAfterSync: Lock was registered on TTLock but not found after sync. Sync again from Unlinked tab, then use Link existing.
ttlockCloudListFailed: Could not load locks from TTLock cloud on the phone. Check internet and TTLock credentials on the server.
unlockNoLockLinked: No lock is linked to this unit.
roomHasLockMessage: Unlink the current lock from the lock details page before adding or linking another.
unitHasLockTitle: This unit already has a lock
unitHasLockMessage: Unlink the current lock from the lock details page before adding or linking another.
